# hostd_project (Resource)

A Public Cloud project. The API key must be allowed to create projects; it gets Full access to the projects it creates. If creation is interrupted, a project with the same name in the same cluster that appeared during the call is kept instead of creating another. A project can be deleted only after all its virtual machines and private networks are removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_project" "main" {
  name         = "production"
  cluster_name = "waw-1"
  description  = "Production workloads"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster (zone) name, e.g. `waw-1`. Changing it replaces the project.
- `name` (String) Project name (up to 255 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Project description (up to 1000 characters). Empty by default.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the project to be created. Defaults to 5 minutes.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the project to be deleted. Defaults to 5 minutes.
- `update` (String) How long to wait for the project to be updated. Defaults to 5 minutes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hostd_project.main 0b6e5f7c-4f4e-4a43-9c0e-6f4d3b2a1c90
```
